tree.strategy: Start from the base rate: how often do events of this exact kind happen? Only move away from that number for specific, concrete evidence.
The status quo usually wins. Things change more slowly than people expect, and most deadlines pass with nothing happening.
Read the resolution rules like a lawyer. Work out exactly what must happen, by exactly when, and how many separate things must all go right.
Follow the incentives. Ask who wants this outcome, who can make it happen, and what it would cost them.

Assume the obvious answer is priced into everyone's thinking. Look for why the popular view is wrong and lean against it.
